title: PriceReference
description: Reference pricing for a billing code. Every figure must carry a data_source and data_year. Numeric fields are nullable because we never invent a number we do not have.

code.description: Billing code this reference applies to.

medicare_price.description: Medicare reference price in US dollars, or null if unknown.

ma_range_low.description: Low end of the Massachusetts hospital price range, or null.

ma_range_high.description: High end of the Massachusetts hospital price range, or null.

data_source.description: Where these figures came from. Required.

data_year.description: Year the reference figures are from. Required.
